index.html: Founder-led mobile, web and applied AI for products that cannot fail. Three partners. Zero intermediaries. Every line of code accountable.

Nexora Studio is a digital engineering studio in Fergana, Uzbekistan. We design and build mobile applications, high-performance web platforms and applied AI systems — for companies and for products of our own.
Three founders. Zero intermediaries. The people who scope your product are the people who architect, build and ship it.
We keep the studio deliberately small, so the scope, the architecture and the shipped product are owned by the same people.
Native-feeling iOS and Android products on React Native and Expo. Fluid gestures, offline resilience and release discipline that survives the store.
Corporate platforms, SaaS dashboards and customer portals built on React 19 and edge infrastructure. Fast at the first paint and coherent at the hundredth screen.
LLM mentors, RAG pipelines and real-time agents with guardrails, structured outputs and genuine product value — not an API wrapper in a new coat.
Two platforms, designed, engineered and operated by the founding team. Each one is live in production.
An AI-guided ascent from school to university.
A national reading platform, engineered to 7 MB.

studio.html: Three founders, on every line. Nexora is a digital engineering studio in Fergana, Uzbekistan — deliberately small, and accountable from the first sketch to production.
Nexora Studio designs and builds mobile applications, high-performance web platforms and applied AI systems — for companies and for products of our own.
Our benchmark is not the local market. It is the finest digital work produced anywhere. That standard shows up in architecture, performance and the small details users feel before they can name them.
Nexora did not begin as an agency. It began with products the founders had to design, ship and run themselves.

The three founders built Arise, an AI-guided admissions platform for students in Uzbekistan. A multilingual mentor, a personal roadmap and a mobile product measured in production — not in a pitch deck.
DigitalLib followed: a national reading platform with 713 books, a private academic vault and a 7 MB Android build made for the connections people actually have.

The collaboration became a studio. Nexora now applies the same standard — strategy, design, engineering and operations under one roof — to a deliberately small number of client engagements each quarter.
In-house products and client work share the same founders, the same architecture reviews and the same launch discipline. Nothing is handed to a team you have never met.
We keep the studio deliberately small. The people who scope your product are the people who architect, build and ship it.
Native-feeling iOS and Android products on React Native and Expo. Fluid gestures, offline resilience and release discipline that survives the store.
Corporate platforms, SaaS dashboards and customer portals built on React 19 and edge infrastructure. Fast at the first paint and coherent at the hundredth screen.
LLM mentors, RAG pipelines and real-time agents with guardrails, structured outputs and genuine product value — not an API wrapper in a new coat.
Design systems · Motion · Art direction · Brand engineering
Figures from our shipped products. No projections, no laboratory conditions — the numbers our users actually experience.
Verified questions in the knowledge arena
Four stages, no relay race. The founders stay on the project from the first sketch to the release and beyond.
We dissect the product, the audience and the constraint that matters. The output is a route, not a wish list.
Clickable screens, a design system and a system architecture you can interrogate before a line of code is written.
Two-week cycles with working builds on your phone and a live staging environment. You review the product, not a status deck.
Store deployment, monitoring and measured iteration. We stay responsible after the invoice — as we do on our own products.
Two engagements per quarter, scoped directly with the founders. Tell us what needs to exist and when.

work.html: Two platforms of our own, designed, engineered and operated by the founding team. The imagery below is from the live products.
An AI-guided ascent from school to university.
A study and career-guidance ecosystem for students. Arise pairs university matching with Ari, a multilingual AI mentor that turns an ambition into a weekly route.

Ari — a mentor fluent in English, Russian and Uzbek
Skill trees, streak rituals and milestone tracking that make progress visible
A national reading platform, engineered to 7 MB.
A digital reading hub for Uzbek literature and academic material. A private vault, an adaptive reader with TTS, and a gamified knowledge arena — fast on the connections people actually have.
Personal private vault for syllabi, notes and PDFs
Alif AI librarian for recommendations, summaries and study plans
Both platforms are live and operated by Nexora Studio.

Arise is a study and career-guidance ecosystem for students in Uzbekistan. It connects a student's ambition to a concrete route: university matching, skill-building and an AI mentor who knows the path.
Ari, the platform's multilingual mentor, constructs milestones around each goal and stays inside the product's guardrails. The result is guidance that feels personal without inventing facts.
Personal admissions roadmap, matched to dream universities
Gamified skill trees, streak rituals and milestone tracking
Native mobile performance with offline resilience
Planning an education, health or AI product?
Digital reading in Central Asia was split between disordered Telegram channels and archaic portals that were never built for a phone. DigitalLib replaces both with one coherent reading space.

The platform combines a verified national catalogue, a private academic vault, an adaptive reader with text-to-speech, and an arena of chapter-level quizzes. It is fast enough to work where the network is not.
Instant in-browser reading without filling device storage
Private vault for syllabi, notes and PDFs
Alif AI librarian — recommendations, summaries and study plans
1,256 verified quiz questions with XP and reader ranks
7.05 MB Android APK, built for low-bandwidth regions
Building a platform for a market that has been underserved?
